title: CISA® Certification (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
body: Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA)
source: ISACA CISA 2024-2025 Updated Job Practice Framework
summary: The premier global benchmark for professionals who audit, control, monitor, and assess an organization's information technology and business systems, updated to the August 2024 Job Practice framework across 5 re-weighted domains.

standard.name: Standard CISA Track
standard.blurb: Pass the 150-question examination (scaled score 450/800) and verify 5 years of qualifying professional experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Eligibility & Audit Process Foundations
stages.subtitle: Audit standards, risk-based planning, and IT governance

nodes.name: Domain 1: Information Systems Auditing Process
nodes.description: ITAF standards, risk-based audit planning, internal controls, CAATs, sampling techniques, audit evidence, reporting, and QAIP.
topics: ISACA ITAF Assurance Standards and Code of Professional Ethics
Risk-Based IS Audit Planning & Audit Universe Definition
Types of Controls: ITGCs, Application Controls, Compensating Controls
Audit Execution: CAATs, Data Analytics, Statistical Sampling & Evidence Gathering
Communicating Audit Results & Exit Conferences

nodes.name: Domain 2: Governance & Management of IT
nodes.description: IT governance frameworks (COBIT), IT organizational structure, strategic alignment, policies, risk management, and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM).
topics: IT Strategy Committees & Board Oversight
COBIT 2019 Principles & Governance Components
IT Policies, Standards, Procedures & Segregation of Duties (SoD)
Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) & SOC 1/SOC 2 Evaluation
IT Risk Management & Legal/Regulatory Privacy Compliance (GDPR, HIPAA)

stages.title: Stage 2: Systems Lifecycle & Operational Resilience
stages.subtitle: Systems acquisition, development, operations, and business resilience

nodes.name: Domain 3: Information Systems Acquisition, Development & Implementation
nodes.description: Project governance, business case development, SDLC methodologies (Agile, DevOps, CI/CD), testing strategies, and post-implementation reviews.
topics: Project Management Methodologies & PMBOK/Agile Frameworks
SDLC Security: Secure Coding, Code Reviews & DevSecOps
System Migration, Cutover Strategies & Parallel Runs
Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR) & Benefits Realization

nodes.name: Domain 4: Information Systems Operations & Business Resilience
nodes.description: IT service management (ITIL), database management, cloud architectures (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), backup management, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP).
topics: IT Service Management & Incident/Problem/Change Management (ITIL)
Database Management Systems & Cloud Virtualization Controls
Business Impact Analysis (BIA), RTO, RPO & MTD Metrics
Disaster Recovery Testing (Tabletop, Parallel, Full Interruption)
Resilient Cloud Architectures & Hybrid Multi-Cloud Controls

stages.title: Stage 3: Information Asset Protection & Licensure
stages.subtitle: Security architecture, 150-question exam, and 5 years experience

nodes.name: Domain 5: Protection of Information Assets
nodes.description: Information security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), Zero Trust, Identity and Access Management (IAM), network security, PKI, and incident response.
topics: Information Security Governance & ISO/IEC 27001 / NIST CSF
Zero Trust Architecture & Least Privilege Enforcement
Identity and Access Management (IAM), MFA, SSO & Privileged Access (PAM)
Network Security: Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS 1.3, Micro-segmentation & Zero Day
Security Incident Response, Digital Forensics & Ransomware Containment

nodes.name: CISA Computer-Based Examination
nodes.description: 150-question examination administered at Prometric test centers or via remote proctoring. Requires scaled score of 450 out of 800 to pass.
checklists: Achieve scaled score of at least 450 out of 800

nodes.name: 5 Years Verified IS Audit/Control/Security Work Experience
nodes.description: Submit proof of 5 years of qualifying IS audit, control, or security work experience (substitutions available for university degrees and related credentials).
topics: 5-Year Work Verification
Experience Waiver Options (Bachelor's/Master's/CPA)

nodes.name: Annual CPE Compliance & Code of Ethics
nodes.description: Maintain certification through payment of annual maintenance fees, earning at least 20 CPE hours annually (120 hours over 3-year cycle), and adhering to ISACA Code of Ethics.
topics: Annual 20 CPE Minimum
120 CPE over 3 Years
ISACA Code of Ethics Adherence
